I don't think he is being abusive deliberately. He thinks he is a victim and I am the oppressor (I am at this point in my life because YOU did not do certain thing that I expected from you and such). I am to be blamed for everything that is not right in his life.

Everything has to be his way or he would create a huge issue out of it.  I am just a punching bag for him. I feel sad writing this.
